outcome: Retire DriftSeal and run the repository on Inkan: freeze the DriftSeal outcome history as a static archive, move the agent protocol and every live path reference to Inkan, and remove the duplicated MADR tree
criteria: .seal/HISTORY.md renders all 21 DriftSeal outcomes and is readable without the driftseal binary
AGENTS.md carries the Inkan protocol block only; both DriftSeal blocks are gone, and the structure table lists .inkan/ and describes .seal/ as a frozen archive
HANDOFF.md and README.md name inkan commands and .inkan/decisions/ paths; no driftseal command or .seal/madr/ path remains outside the archive
.seal/madr/ is removed and inkan doctor reports 12 decisions
The DataSpace measurement record and the driftseal-reconciliation history inside the migrated decision files are unchanged

dispositions.note: HANDOFF.md and README.md are clean. The surviving driftseal mentions are all history the next criterion protects: the archive itself, and the Decision History notes in .inkan/decisions/ that record what driftseal absorb did to the ids in 2026-08-28.

note: DriftSeal is retired; the repository runs on Inkan. .seal/HISTORY.md is the frozen rendering of driftseal log --all --all-lanes (21 outcomes, 302 lines), written so the history stays readable if the driftseal binary goes away; .seal/outcomes/events.jsonl is kept beside it untouched. AGENTS.md lost both DriftSeal protocol blocks and now carries the Inkan block alone, with .inkan/ added to the structure table and .seal/ described as a read-only archive. HANDOFF.md points at inkan status and inkan log -n 3, names .inkan/decisions/, and says where the DriftSeal-era outcome ids it cites can still be read. README.md's two MADR paths moved to .inkan/decisions/. The duplicated .seal/madr/ tree is removed; the 12 records live only in .inkan/decisions/ with ids 0001-0012 intact, so the roughly 60 MADR references across code and docs still resolve, and inkan doctor reports 12 decisions. No code, test or measurement file changed. .gitignore was left alone: .claude/ and .agents/ stay ignored, so the use-inkan skill is local-only and a fresh clone takes the protocol from AGENTS.md, which is self-sufficient.
